lore.bio:
Rampart is a blue-collar, private business owner who just needs a big gun and a backpack full of scrap metal to get by in the dangerous, wild west world of the Outlands. Before opening her popular modding shop on Gaea, Ramya Parekh (Rampart for short) made a name for herself in the underground gauntlet circuit. Parekh climbed to the top showcasing pure skill using her custom-modded gear. She began taking jobs from smugglers, Syndicate members, and everyone in between. Some say it ain’t great unless it’s got “Rampart” written on it.
Parekh never shied away from letting people know how great she was, or better yet, how bad they were. Maybe that’s what led a group of assailants to ambush her at her shop one night. Her business burned down and she was left with nothing -- except an Apex Card. For Parekh, the Apex card is more than just an invitation to compete - it's a sign that she may have lost her shop, but she didn't lose what built it. Like her motto says, she's the kind of person who can always "turn crap into gold.”

For more information on Rampart's story, see Rampart (character).

passive.name: Battle Modder
passive.description: Increased magazine/heat capacity and faster reloads/recharge when using LMGs and the Minigun. Amped Cover permanently gains health with each Evo level.

tactical.name: Amped Cover
tactical.description: Build a crouch-cover wall, which deploys a full-cover amped wall that blocks incoming shots and amps outgoing shots. Damage through or to Amped Cover charges the wall. Passing over the wall converts charges to a sprint boost.

ultimate.name: Mobile Minigun "Sheila"
ultimate.description: Wield a mobile minigun with a single high capacity magazine. Place it down for anyone to use as a stationary and reloadable turret.

tactics.playstyle: The team's bastion. Rampart requires anticipation to place her amped covers. She heavily punishes anyone who dares cross her in the open, and Sheila melts doors and shields alike.

left.name: Combat Reserve
left.description: Bigger ammo stacks, extra grenades slots, access red weapon supply bins.

right.name: Locked and Loaded
right.description: Gain faster reloads and infinite ammo when behind Amped Cover and shield is intact.

left.name: Ramped Up
left.description: Improved Mobile Sheila handling and spin-up time by 20%.

right.name: Rebuild Module
right.description: Amped Cover will regenerate health and rebuild shield section after not being damaged for a period of time.
